answer: Sybil resistance derives from EigenTrust-style matrix factorization combined with reciprocity-weighted transitivity and exponential temporal decay: reputation loses half its weight every fixed interval, so an identity must provide sustained, mutually validated honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil, whether named anchor, ember, or willow, has near-zero eigenvector centrality, no trusted incoming mass, and therefore cannot accumulate sufficient consensus weight before its claims decay.
